listings.title: Piramal Vaikunth, Balkum: 1–4 BHK Homes & Townhomes in Thane West
listings.excerpt: 32-acre gated community by Piramal Realty in Balkum, Thane West, overlooking Yeoor Hills and Thane Creek. 1 to 4 BHK homes and duplex townhomes.
listings.content:
Piramal Vaikunth is Piramal Realty's 32-acre gated community at Balkum, Thane West, set between the Yeoor Hills and Thane Creek on the Eastern Express Highway side of Thane.

The project is planned as five clusters with 12 towers, offering 1 BHK, 1 BHK + study, 2 BHK, 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments plus duplex townhomes. Earlier clusters have been delivered with Occupancy Certificates and are home to residents today, while later towers in Cluster 3 are being sold now.

Residents get large landscaped open spaces, clubhouse facilities and quick access to the Eastern Express Highway, the Ghodbunder Road belt and the upcoming Thane metro lines.

Each tower has its own MahaRERA registration. Ask us for the current price sheet, available floors and offers for the tower you like.

listings.title: Lodha Amara, Kolshet Road: 1, 2 & 3 BHK Flats in Thane West
listings.excerpt: Large Lodha township on Kolshet Road, Thane West, with 1, 2 and 3 BHK homes from about 446 to 1,266 sq.ft carpet. Ready and under-construction towers.
listings.content:
Lodha Amara is one of the largest residential townships on Kolshet Road in Thane West, developed in phases by the Lodha Group. Several towers are already occupied while newer towers are under construction.

Homes range from compact 1 BHKs to 3 BHKs, roughly 446 to 1,266 sq.ft of carpet area depending on the tower. The township has landscaped gardens, clubhouse and sports facilities, and is close to Kapurbawdi, Majiwada, Ghodbunder Road and the Thane–Belapur corridor.

Lodha's own campaign page has quoted prices starting from about ₹89 lakh for entry units; prices vary by tower, floor and view.

Each phase has its own MahaRERA registration. Ask us for live availability and the latest price sheet.

listings.title: Kalpataru Parkcity, Kolshet Road: 100-Acre Township with 1–4 BHK Homes
listings.excerpt: Kalpataru's 100-acre integrated township on Kolshet Road, Thane, built around a 20.5-acre central park. 1 to 4 BHK homes across phases such as Eternia and Immensa.
listings.content:
Kalpataru Parkcity is a 100-acre integrated township by the Kalpataru Group on Kolshet Road, Thane West, planned around a 20.5-acre central park. Over 2,000 families already live in the completed phases.

The township is being built in phases, including Eternia (high-rise towers of up to 47 floors with 2 and 3 BHK homes) and Immensa (towers of about 43 floors with 1, 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes). Earlier phases offered compact 1 and 2 BHK homes.

Kolshet Road is a fast-growing residential belt between Balkum and Ghodbunder Road, with quick access to Thane station, the Eastern Express Highway and the upcoming metro.

Phases are registered separately on MahaRERA. Ask us which phase fits your budget and for current prices.

listings.title: Puneet Kalpavriksha, Nehru Nagar: 1 RK, 1 BHK & 2 BHK in Kurla East
listings.excerpt: Compact 1 RK, 1 BHK, 1.5 BHK and 2 BHK homes by Puneet Group at Nehru Nagar, Kurla East. MahaRERA P51800030146. About 279 to 600 sq.ft carpet.
listings.content:
Puneet Kalpavriksha is a residential project by the Puneet Group at Nehru Nagar, Kurla East, offering compact city homes for first-time buyers and investors.

Configurations include 1 RK, 1 BHK, 1.5 BHK and 2 BHK, with carpet areas of roughly 279 to 600 sq.ft. Kurla is one of Mumbai's best-connected suburbs: Kurla station is on both the Central and Harbour lines, with quick road access to BKC, the Eastern Express Highway, LBS Marg and the Santacruz–Chembur Link Road.

MahaRERA registration P51800030146. Ask us for the current availability, price and possession status.

listings.title: Central Park by Harmain, Kausa: 1, 2 & 3 BHK in Mumbra
listings.excerpt: Large under-construction project by Harmain Enterprises in Kausa, Mumbra: 639 homes in 3 buildings, 1 to 3 BHK. MahaRERA P51700034243, proposed possession April 2028.
listings.content:
Central Park by Harmain Enterprises is one of the larger new residential projects in Kausa, Mumbra, with 639 homes planned across three buildings.

It offers 1, 2 and 3 BHK apartments, making it a budget-friendly option within Thane district for families who want more space for the money. Mumbra station on the Central Railway main line and the Mumbra bypass connect the area to Thane, Kalyan and Navi Mumbai via Shil Phata.

MahaRERA registration P51700034243, proposed possession April 2028 as filed on MahaRERA. Ask us for current prices and the payment plan.

listings.title: Lodha Alibaug: 4 BHK Private Villas & Townhouses
listings.excerpt: Lodha's villa community in Alibaug with 4 BHK private townhouses and mansions. MahaRERA P52000078856, possession expected around December 2028.
listings.content:
Lodha Alibaug is the Lodha Group's private villa community in Alibaug, offering 4 BHK townhouses and mansions designed as weekend and second homes for Mumbai families.

Alibaug is now much closer to Mumbai by road via Atal Setu, and by ferry from the Gateway of India and Ferry Wharf to Mandwa. A gated villa community with MahaRERA registration avoids the title and NA-permission risks of buying individual plots.

MahaRERA registration P52000078856; possession is expected around December 2028. Ask us for the price sheet, villa sizes and a site visit.

listings.title: Embassy Serenity, Alibaug: 52 Luxury Villa Residences
listings.excerpt: Embassy Developments' Alibaug villa project: 52 residences with 52% open green space. Phase I received MahaRERA approval in February 2026; possession targeted for 2030.
listings.content:
Embassy Serenity is Embassy Developments' luxury residential project in Alibaug. Phase I received MahaRERA approval in February 2026.

The project is planned as just 52 residences with about 52% of the land kept as open green space and a traffic-free podium, and is described in listings as 3 and 4 BHK villas. Possession is targeted for 2030.

With Atal Setu cutting the drive from Mumbai and fast ferries to Mandwa, Alibaug villa projects from established developers are among the most sought-after second homes near the city.

Ask us for the MahaRERA number of the phase, villa sizes, prices and early-booking offers.
